verdict.rationale: No first-party Nitrokey doc in the pack covers registering a backup key or explains what can and cannot be recovered after a key is lost. The only related evidence is a community report that the Nitrokey HSM supports offline escrow of key material (an AES-encrypted paper backup via DKEK). That gives glancing support for key-material recoverability on one model only. Missing for 10: vendor-documented backup-key enrollment guidance, an explicit statement of what is and is not recoverable on loss (e.g., FIDO2 resident keys, on-device-generated OpenPGP keys), recovery guidance for the Nitrokey 3 line, and independent corroboration beyond one HN comment.
